verses.text: Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro to a winhaj Salomón ix och reyal sk'exulok winh smam, ix yak'ankot heb' schekab' winh yik tzul lolon heb' yet' winh, yujto te wach'taxon yak'an winh yet' winhaj David.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxib'at winhaj Salomón t'a winhaj Hiram chi' icha tik:

Ha ach tik ojtak to maj yal-laj sb'oankank'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal winh in mam yujto niwan tiempoal ix yak' owal winh, masanto a Jehová ix ak'anoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Ha tiknaik jun, toxo ix yak' junk'olal Jehová t'ayonh israel onh tik, manhxalaj heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh, manhxalaj chukal b'aj tzonh xiwi.

Yuj chi', toxo ix in na' to ol in b'ok'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal, icha ajnak yalan t'a winh in mam chi', ayik yalannak icha tik: Ha junok uninal ol ochkan t'a yol sdespacho a k'exulok, ha' ol b'oank'e junok in templo, xchi Jehová t'a winh in mam chi'.

Yuj chi', tzin k'an t'ayach to ol a chek ik'jokel ste'al, haton te' k'ute' t'a Líbano. Ol wak'b'at heb' winh in chekab' yik skolwaj heb' winh yet' heb' winh a chekab' chi'. Ol in tup sk'u heb' winh icha jantak tza k'ana', yujto ojtak to malaj junok onh syal kik'anel te' icha ex aj Sidón ex chi', xchib'at winh.

Ix te tzalaj winhaj Hiram chi' ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yalb'at winhaj Salomón chi'. Ix yalan winh: Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto ix yak' jun yuninal winhaj David te nhikan ix ochkan sk'exulok skuchb'an jun niwan chonhab' chi', xchi winh.
Elanhchamel ix yalxikot winh t'a winhaj Salomón chi': Toxo ix wab' tas ix alkoti, tik tzin chek ik'jokel te' k'ute' yet' te' taj icha ix al chi', ol wak'b'at te' t'ayach.

Ol yik'emta te' heb' winh in chekab' t'a Líbano, ol emk'och te' t'a sti' ha' mar. Yaman ol aj te' yik ol laj b'at te' t'a yib'anh ha', icha chi' ol aj sk'och te' b'aj ix ala'. Hata' ol he cha te', ol eyik'anb'at te' b'i'an. Ha hachxo jun, ol ak'kot tas ol in wa yet' heb' anima t'a in palacio tik stojolok te', xchikot winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aj yak'an te' k'ute' winhaj Hiram yet' te' taj ix och yopisio yuj winhaj Salomón chi'.
Haxo winhaj Salomón chi' ix ak'an jantak tas tz'och yuj winhaj Hiram chi' t'a junjun ab'il: 75 mil quintal ixim trigo yet' 115 mil galón aceite yik sat te' olivo.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji sjelanil spensar winhaj Salomón chi' yuj Jehová, icha ix aj yalani. Ix sb'o'an strato winh yet' winhaj Hiram chi' yik ay junk'olal t'a skal heb' winh schawanhil.

Ix schek winhaj Salomón chi' to ha t'a masanil yol yik Israel smolchaj heb' winh winak to yowalil sb'at t'a munlajel t'a Líbano. Ha sb'isul heb' winh chi', 30 mil heb' winh t'a smasanil. 10 mil heb' winh schekjib'at t'a junjun uj. Jun ujal xit'ek' heb' winh munlajel t'a Líbano chi', chab' ujal ayek' heb' winh t'a spat. Ha winhaj Adoniram ayoch yajalilok heb' winh 30 mil chi'.
Ay pax 70 mil heb' winh kuchum ikatz. Ay pax 80 mil heb' winh tzeyum k'e'en t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Israel chi'.
Ch'ok pax yaj oxe' mil 300 heb' winh ayoch t'a caporalil yilan munlajel chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Salomón chi' to stzeyji k'e'en niwak k'e'en, wach' tz'aj k'e'en stzeyji yik wach' a k'e'en tz'emkan yichok stemplo Jehová chi'.

Ha heb' winh smunlajwum winhaj Salomón yet' heb' winh yik winhaj Hiram chi' yet' pax heb' winh kajan t'a Gebal, ix sjoch te te' heb' winh, ix stzeyanpax k'e'en k'e'en heb' winh yik tz'och t'a templo chi'.
